name: CoreWorkforce
intent: Workforce management scaffold: a full app shell (CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar) with a single "Workforce" sidebar entry, and a route header (PageContentHeader) carrying four tabs — Analytics, Workers List, Submissions, Compliance — plus a Settings action that opens a SideMenu settings sub-surface (Trade, Workshifts, Discipline, Location Group, Card Generator). Workers List is built out: a MetricCard KPI row, Mobilized/Demobilized tabs, and a DataTable with search, column toggle, row selection, Upload Images / Export / Add Worker(s) toolbar actions, and a PushPanel hosting the WorkerProfile widget, opened by clicking a worker.
when: Starting the Workforce product surface that owns its own app shell
A single-section app whose route content is organized by a peer tab set in the header
whenNot: A content page rendered inside an existing app shell -> use a content-only template
A multi-section admin surface where the left nav switches content -> use Admin Panel

chooseOver.component: Assembling CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar + PageContentHeader by hand
chooseOver.because: Workforce owns the shell and the route header so workforce surfaces plug straight in.

allowedPlacement: route-level workforce surface that owns the full window

extracted: four-tab route header scaffold (Analytics / Workers List / Submissions / Compliance) with a Settings action
Workers List roster surface (KPI row + DataTable + PushPanel worker profile)

lineage.confidence: unset — scaffold, no held-out eval yet
notes: Workers List modelled on the live portal workforce roster
Analytics / Submissions / Compliance bodies still placeholders
